title: Craftable Eazy Totems Of Undying
description: Adds a crafting recipe for the Totem of Undying.
body:
Craftable Totem
Adds a crafting recipe for the Totem of Undying.

Recipe
 
E G E
G N G
G
 
E = Emerald
G = Gold Ingot
N = Nether Star

Works in survival and multiplayer.
Uses only vanilla items.

Minecraft 26.1.2
Forge 64.0.1
